name: sf90-research-empty
note: Every worker returned empty; the report must degrade without invented numbers. hand-converted 2026-08-17 from the recorded freeform findings into typed comps, each as its source stated it.

areas.description: Front bumper cover, splitter, and both headlight assemblies completely torn off; fascia support brackets bent. This is a bolt-on panel loss but extensive - full front clip replacement needed.

Front wheel/hub/knuckle assemblies exposed with fascia gone; wheel angle and hub visibility suggest possible control arm or knuckle damage on at least the right front, though tires/wheels themselves look undamaged and not knocked into severe camber.

Rear bumper cover and diffuser missing, exposing exhaust tips and orange high-voltage hybrid cabling and cooling lines. No visible impact deformation to rear structural crash rails, appears to be disassembly/parts removal rather than rear collision damage.

With front fascia removed, radiator support and front crush structure are visible but photos do not clearly show rail bending or frame crumple; front-end hit appears moderate-to-heavy but structural rail integrity cannot be confirmed from these angles.
Small spider crack visible in corner of windshield in dash cluster photo; otherwise glass intact.
Cabin, seats, dash, and steering wheel appear clean and undamaged with no airbag deployment evident; low mileage (3004 mi) confirmed on cluster.

Dash cluster shows multiple warning lights and 'System not programmed' message, plus exposed orange high-voltage hybrid cabling at rear with covers removed - requires full HV isolation check before any handling.

observations.note: Front clip severely damaged - both front wheels/suspension exposed, front bumper and fenders torn away, front-right suspension knuckle/hub visibly displaced, headlight assembly gone
Left side view showing front bumper/fender torn off, front wheel assembly exposed and suspension components visible, rear intact with yellow tow strap
Rear quarter view - rear bumper cover and diffuser missing, exposing exhaust, hybrid wiring harness, and structural rear crash members; wheels/tires appear undamaged
Front three-quarter view confirms front bumper, splitter and headlights completely torn away, front fascia support brackets bent, radiator support visible and possibly displaced
Straight-on front view showing collapsed front fascia, cracked/torn front bumper cover hanging, hood shut line intact but front lower structure damaged
Rear view showing exhaust tips, hybrid battery cooling lines, and rear bumper/diffuser missing entirely - taillights present but rear crash structure exposed
Interior driver side - seats, dash, steering wheel appear clean and undamaged, no airbag deployment visible on steering wheel
Interior passenger side/dash view - airbag panel on dash appears intact, no deployment residue visible
Dashboard cluster showing low odometer (3004 mi), multiple warning lights illuminated including hybrid system, brake, and 'System not programmed' message - windshield shows spider-crack in corner
Rear engine cover/glass area - Ferrari badge and rear window intact, lower bumper structure missing
Hood/nose top view - hood and cowl appear straight and undamaged from this angle, confirming damage is concentrated low/front bumper area rather than upper structure
VIN/data plate tag - ZFF96NLA2M0263155, manufactured December 2020, confirms SF90 Stradale model

triage.drivetrainRisk: Rear-mounted V8/hybrid drivetrain itself is not visibly damaged and rear diffuser/bumper removal looks more like disassembly for parts/inspection than impact; however front-end hit reaching the suspension knuckles raises risk of front subframe or steering rack involvement, and exposed hybrid high-voltage lines demand isolation testing before any engine/transmission work is attempted.
